front: Ask a non-ally a charming or needling question with Diplomacy; on success it must answer directly.
back:
Diplomacy vs. target's Will DC; target immune for 1 hour.
Crit Success: must answer directly (not necessarily truthfully); +4 circumstance bonus to your Perception DC if it Lies; it's off-guard to your Devise a Stratagem Strike this turn.
Success: as crit success, but +2 to Perception DC.
Failure: can refuse to answer.
Crit Failure: can refuse; its attitude toward you drops one step.
